registry.description: Rewrite Invoke-WebRequest command tokens to all-lowercase invoke-webrequest.
forbidden_if: indicator appears only inside strings or comments
registry.notes: PowerShell command names are case-insensitive; lowercase form executes identically but tokenizes differently.
preconditions: script contains a standalone Invoke-WebRequest command token
